project_name: Miracurl Suite - Master Admin Dashboard Redesign
theme: Light Sparkling Canvas (Dashboard-only) with Dual-Vertical Tenant Adaptation

scope.dashboard_canvas: Light sparkling background applies ONLY to the Dashboard page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx or sub-views). All other admin pages retain their standard light slate/clean theme.
scope.brand_architecture: Miracurl is the Master Brand across all tenants (Salon & Restaurant). The Miracurl logo MUST be prominently rendered at the top of the sidebar with tenant name displayed directly beneath it. 'Powered by Miracurl' marks are integrated in the top bar and sidebar footer.

rules: Use Playfair Display for primary headers, key metrics focus, and high-impact card titles.
Use Outfit for readable body copy, tabular numbers, navigation items, and button text.
Never use default Inter or generic Sans for main section titles.

dashboard_light_sparkle_canvas.gradient_mesh: radial-gradient(at 10% 10%, rgba(255, 253, 245, 1) 0px, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(at 90% 20%, rgba(254, 243, 199, 0.45) 0px, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(at 50% 80%, rgba(253, 242, 248, 0.50) 0px, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(at 80% 90%, rgba(245, 243, 255, 0.40) 0px, transparent 50%)

light_sparkling_background_implementatio.technique: CSS Radial Shimmer Mesh + CSS Keyframe Glint/Sparkle Layer
light_sparkling_background_implementatio.accessibility_note: Ensures zero motion discomfort via prefers-reduced-motion media query. High contrast AA compliance maintained across all card surfaces with glass opacity set to minimum 0.82.

cards_and_widgets.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85 border border-[#eadfcb]/80 shadow-[0_8px_25px_-5px_rgba(212,175,55,0.08)] rounded-2xl transition-all duration-300
cards_and_widgets.kpi_tiles: p-5 sm:p-6 bg-gradient-to-br from-white/95 via-white/85 to-[#fefcf8]/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-[#eadfcb] rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-200
cards_and_widgets.charts: p-6 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#eadfcb] rounded-2xl shadow-md
cards_and_widgets.pills_and_badges: px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide

sidebar_top.structure: Flex column alignment inside sidebar header
sidebar_top.miracurl_logo: Render <BrandMark /> or Miracurl Master Logo emblem with gold/pink gradient shimmer. Size: text-xl font-bold with sparkling 'CURL' accent.
sidebar_top.tenant_name_sub_block: Directly underneath Miracurl logo: render tenant name (e.g. 'Glamour Velvet Salon' or 'Bistro Elegance') with vertical icon badge (Scissors for Salon, Chef Hat/Utensils for Restaurant), styled in text-xs font-semibold text-amber-200/90 tracking-wide uppercase mt-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/10 border border-white/15 backdrop-blur-sm max-w-[200px] truncate

top_bar.powered_by_mark: Display a elegant pill on the top bar right section or left adjacent to page title: 'Powered by Miracurl' with a mini gold sparkle icon, text-[11px] font-medium text-amber-900/70 bg-amber-50/80 border border-amber-200/60 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full shadow-2xs hover:bg-amber-100/80 transition-colors

sidebar_footer.powered_by_mark: Bottom of dark sidebar: 'Powered by Miracurl' badge with version/tenant info, styled with text-[11px] text-zinc-400 font-medium tracking-wider uppercase flex items-center gap-1.5 opacity-80 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity

micro_interactions.staggered_entrance: Framer Motion or CSS staggered fade-slide-up for dashboard widgets (delay children by 0.05s)
micro_interactions.kpi_hover: Hover lifts card by -2px, darkens amber border tint slightly, enhances soft gold drop shadow
micro_interactions.chart_pin_lock: PIN unlocked reveals smooth blur-to-clear transition

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Apply the .dashboard-sparkle-container class exclusively to the Dashboard parent wrapper in Dashboard.jsx.
2. Ensure tenant vertical tint variables (--tenant-sparkle-tint) switch dynamically based on tenant.business_type or vertical ('salon' -> rose pink, 'restaurant' -> warm amber).
3. Update AppLayout.jsx sidebar header so Miracurl logo is ALWAYS shown prominently at top, with tenant name and vertical indicator pill directly underneath.
4. Add 'Powered by Miracurl' pill mark in the AppLayout top bar and sidebar footer.
5. Keep all existing widgets, PIN lock behaviors, charts, and functionality intact while layering the light sparkling canvas aesthetic and glass cards.
6. Verify all data-testids exist on the corresponding containers and interactive controls.
